articles.title: Billionaire investor warns sports prediction markets harm men
articles.mainIdea: Billionaire investor warns sports prediction markets harm men
articles.summary: Bloomberg: Billionaire investor warns sports prediction markets harm men. (Bloomberg) -- John Arnold, the billionaire energy trader-turned-philanthropist, made his fortune by predicting the direction of markets. Now, he’s sounding the alarm on fast-growing prediction markets, saying they’re harmful to young men and boys.His concern lies in how platforms for sports-event contracts and online betting more broadly are designed to keep users constantly engaged.
